# RULES.md

Binding constraints for agent-assisted work in this repository. Recommendations belong in [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md). Entry points and verification are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [TESTING.md](TESTING.md).

Human-authored guidance in `CLAUDE.md`, `realworld/CLAUDE.md`, and `realworld/CONTRIBUTING.md` takes precedence over harness files when they conflict; record conflicts for review rather than overriding them.

---

## RULE-01: Do not change application code when planning or writing harness files only

**Rule:** Agents must not modify application source, production configs, lockfiles, or CI workflow files when the task is limited to harness documentation (`AGENTS.md`, skills, `RULES.md`, and related Markdown under the harness catalog).

**Scope:** Repository root harness files; `skills/**`; [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md); [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md); excludes intentional feature or bug-fix tasks on `src/app/**`, `package.json` scripts wiring, and `playwright.config.ts` when explicitly requested.

**Basis:** Platform harness contract (R6); [platform/init/INIT.md](platform/init/INIT.md) scope.

**Check:** Diff touches only paths listed in harness plans; no edits under `src/app/**` unless the user task targets implementation.

---

## RULE-02: Cite evidence paths for material claims

**Rule:** Every material finding in harness output must cite at least one repository path or code identifier that appears in the inventory or supplied evidence.

**Scope:** All harness Markdown and agent summaries.

**Basis:** Init rule R1; [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

**Check:** Review prose for claims without evidence paths; label inferences explicitly (see RULE-03).

---

## RULE-03: Label inferences

**Rule:** Statements not read directly from repository evidence must be marked as inferred (for example “(inferred)” in Markdown).

**Scope:** Harness files and architecture summaries.

**Basis:** Init rule R2; [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

**Check:** Non-evidence claims include an inference marker.

---

## RULE-04: Preserve human-authored guidance; do not contradict it

**Rule:** Do not copy `CLAUDE.md`, `realworld/CLAUDE.md`, or `realworld/CONTRIBUTING.md` in full into harness files; link or name them in `code`. Do not contradict their instructions; list conflicts for human review.

**Scope:** Root and local `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md).

**Basis:** Init rule R5; [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md); `realworld/CLAUDE.md`; `realworld/CONTRIBUTING.md`.

**Check:** Harness sections point to source files with one-line summaries instead of duplicating long passages.

---

## RULE-05: Match frontend E2E UI contract in SELECTORS.md

**Rule:** SPA changes that affect tests must keep routes, DOM selectors, `localStorage` key `jwtToken`, and `window.__conduit_debug__` (`getToken`, `getAuthState`, `getCurrentUser`) aligned with `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`.

**Scope:** `src/app/**`; shared specs under `realworld/specs/e2e/**`.

**Basis:** [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md); `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`; E2E specs such as `realworld/specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts` and `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`.

**Check:** `bun run test:e2e` (status: documented; see [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-06: Gate SPA-only HTTP client tests with BROWSER_API

**Rule:** Specs that use `page.route()` to assert client-side status handling must call `test.skip(!BROWSER_API, ...)` and must not run as mandatory checks when `BROWSER_API` is false.

**Scope:** `realworld/specs/e2e/*.spec.ts`; `realworld/specs/e2e/helpers/config.ts`.

**Basis:** `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts`; [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md).

**Check:** Grep for `BROWSER_API` in edited specs; run focused E2E per [TESTING.md](TESTING.md).

---

## RULE-07: Follow E2E isolation pattern after each test

**Rule:** Domain E2E specs under `realworld/specs/e2e/` must use `test.afterEach` that awaits `context.close()` and waits approximately 500 ms when extending existing suites, matching `articles.spec.ts`, `comments.spec.ts`, `navigation.spec.ts`, and `social.spec.ts`.

**Scope:** `realworld/specs/e2e/*.spec.ts`.

**Basis:** `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts`; shared skill `add-e2e-domain-spec`.

**Check:** Code review of new or changed `test.afterEach` blocks; `bun run test:e2e` on touched files (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-08: Colocate Angular unit tests with implementation

**Rule:** Service and feature unit tests stay next to the code they cover under `src/app/**` as `*.spec.ts`, following existing files such as `src/app/core/auth/services/jwt.service.spec.ts` and `src/app/features/article/services/articles.service.spec.ts`.

**Scope:** `src/app/**`.

**Basis:** [src/app/AGENTS.md](src/app/AGENTS.md); Vitest via `package.json` (`bun run test`).

**Check:** `bun run test` (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-09: Run Prettier via lint-staged on commit

**Rule:** Staged files must pass `npx lint-staged` before commit when the Husky pre-commit hook is enabled.

**Scope:** Git staged files (lint-staged globs not fully excerpted in supplied evidence).

**Basis:** `.husky/pre-commit`; [HOOKS.md](HOOKS.md).

**Check:** Commit triggers hook; on failure fix formatting and re-stage. Manual: `bun run format:check` (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-10: Keep Bruno collection in sync with Hurl source

**Rule:** Changes to `realworld/specs/api/hurl/*.hurl` must be reflected in generated `realworld/specs/api/bruno/` via `realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js`; CI check mode must pass when Bruno is part of the change.

**Scope:** `realworld/specs/api/hurl/**`; `realworld/specs/api/bruno/**`; `realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js`.

**Basis:** `realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js`; `realworld/.github/workflows/bruno-check.yml`; [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md).

**Check:** `bun realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js --check` (status: documented; [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md)).

---

## RULE-11: Implement REST API against OpenAPI contract

**Rule:** Backend-facing behavior and API test expectations must align with `realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml` (Token auth in `Authorization` header, documented paths such as `/users/login`, `/articles`, `/articles/{slug}/comments`).

**Scope:** API integration in `src/app/**`; contract tests under `realworld/specs/api/**`.

**Basis:** [CONTRACTS.md](CONTRACTS.md); `realworld/specs/api/openapi.yml`; [DOMAIN.md](DOMAIN.md).

**Check:** API runners in `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh` and `realworld/specs/api/run-api-tests-bruno.sh` per [realworld/AGENTS.md](realworld/AGENTS.md) (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-12: Run security E2E separately from the default suite

**Rule:** Specs tagged `@security` (for example `realworld/specs/e2e/xss-security.spec.ts`) are run with `bun run test:e2e:security`, not as the default `test:e2e` grep filter (`--grep-invert @security` on the main script).

**Scope:** `realworld/specs/e2e/**`; root `package.json` scripts.

**Basis:** Root `package.json`; `.github/workflows/security-tests.yml`; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md).

**Check:** `bun run test:e2e:security` (status: documented); default `bun run test:e2e` must not require security-only tags to pass for routine changes.

---

## RULE-13: Use shared Playwright base configuration

**Rule:** Root `playwright.config.ts` must extend `baseConfig` from `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts` for `testDir`, timeouts, worker policy, and chromium project defaults.

**Scope:** `playwright.config.ts`; `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts`.

**Basis:** `realworld/specs/e2e/playwright.base.ts`; [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

**Check:** Import of `baseConfig` in `playwright.config.ts`; `bun run test:e2e` (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-14: Do not commit secrets

**Rule:** Harness files, skills, and agent output must not include API keys, tokens, or credentials, even if they appear in local env files.

**Scope:** All repository paths and agent responses.

**Basis:** Init guardrails; harness safety expectations in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

**Check:** Review diffs for `.env`, tokens, and live credential literals.

---

## RULE-15: Show API errors with `.error-messages` without breaking the form

**Rule:** When the Conduit API returns client errors (for example 400, 401, 403), the SPA must surface messages in `.error-messages` and keep the page usable, as asserted in `realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts`.

**Scope:** `src/app/**`; error and auth flows covered by shared E2E.

**Basis:** `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`; `realworld/specs/e2e/error-handling.spec.ts`; [src/app/features/AGENTS.md](src/app/features/AGENTS.md).

**Check:** `bun run test:e2e` with specs that mock API failures when `BROWSER_API` is true (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-16: Treat any 2xx DELETE response as success in the SPA

**Rule:** Article and comment delete flows in the UI must complete successfully when the backend returns a 2xx status including 200, not only 204, as covered by SPA route-mock tests in the shared suite.

**Scope:** `src/app/**`; `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`; `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts`.

**Basis:** [GUIDELINES.md](GUIDELINES.md); `realworld/specs/e2e/articles.spec.ts`, `realworld/specs/e2e/comments.spec.ts`.

**Check:** Run relevant E2E with `BROWSER_API` enabled (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-17: Create git commits only when the user asks

**Rule:** Agents must not run `git commit`, amend, or push unless the user explicitly requests it in the task or a user rule; when committing, follow the repository git safety protocol (no config changes, no destructive git commands unless requested).

**Scope:** All agent-driven git operations.

**Basis:** User rules in session; [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) alignment with contributor workflow.

**Check:** No unsolicited commits in agent history; commit messages match change purpose when commits are requested.

---

## RULE-18: Null profile fields must match conformance E2E expectations

**Rule:** When API `image` or `bio` is null, the SPA must show `default-avatar.svg`, empty bio (not the literal string `null`), and correct `/settings` form values, as in `realworld/specs/e2e/null-fields.spec.ts`.

**Scope:** `src/app/**` profile and settings UI; `realworld/specs/e2e/null-fields.spec.ts`.

**Basis:** [realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-null-fields-spec/SKILL.md); `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`.

**Check:** `bun run test:e2e -- realworld/specs/e2e/null-fields.spec.ts` (status: documented; path filter inferred; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).

---

## RULE-19: Invalid `jwtToken` must clear auth and show public chrome

**Rule:** After `localStorage` key `jwtToken` is set to an invalid value and the page reloads, the SPA must show unauthenticated UI and cleared token state when `BROWSER_API` is true and `window.__conduit_debug__` is available.

**Scope:** `src/app/**` auth persistence; `realworld/specs/e2e/auth.spec.ts`.

**Basis:** [realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md](realworld/skills/add-e2e-spa-invalid-token-spec/SKILL.md); `realworld/specs/e2e/SELECTORS.md`.

**Check:** `bun run test:e2e` including auth specs (status: documented; [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)).
